items.t: Rapid Micro Biosystems (RPID) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Merck Deal Reframes Analyst Views
items.sum: Rapid Micro Biosystems has seen its assessed fair value fall from US$5.75 to US$3.17 per share as updated models sit closer to the US$0.75 per share cash offer from Merck KGaA.
